WeGrowHealthR: child growth data analysis and reproducible workflows

Source: R/WeGrowHealthR-package.R
WeGrowHealthR-package.Rd

WeGrowHealthR accompanies the books Child Growth Data Analysis and Modeling with R (Book 1) and its advanced companion (Book 2). It is organised in layers.

Details

  • Foundation: wgh_data() (the data contract), wgh_config() (run modes), wgh_sample_flow() (attrition tracking), formatting, the house theme theme_wgh() and export helpers.

  • Method modules: data preparation, WHO z-scores and classification, descriptive epidemiology and trends, trajectories, SITAR growth curves, distributional models, phenotypes, states and transitions, prediction and explanation, causal helpers, and simulation.

  • Flows: one function per paper (wgh_flow_*()) returning a wgh_report with every table, figure and model.

  • Pipeline: wgh_use_pipeline() writes a targets template that chains the flows.

Every example uses simulated data from wgh_simulate(). The simulated cohorts resemble a large school health cohort, so analyses give tables and figures similar to the published ones, but they are not real data and their numbers are not findings.
